window-2.title: Moats That Matter, Cross-Species Communication, & Taking Back Our Attention
window-2.blurb: Belsky reads the near-future like a designer rather than a tech bro, and this one detours from what makes an idea truly yours into AI-decoded animal language and clawing your attention back — basically three side quests in one newsletter.

window-3.title: Carrot Shrub (Nonalcoholic)
window-3.blurb: It's a vinegar-bright, sesame-peppery, glowing-orange drink that starts with you pickling your own baby carrots — a side quest in a glass, and the exact shade of orange that photographs like a dream on film.

window-4.title: Apartamento × LOEWE: Carlota Guerrero at Home, shot by Coco Capitán
window-4.blurb: Three women artists photographed inside their own homes by Coco Capitán — rooms styled like self-portraits, which is basically your whole thesis on living, so go build yourself a corner that photographs like a story about you.

window-5.title: Slow Boat Vinyl Listening Café, Tanjong Pagar
window-5.blurb: A sibling-run listening café up a shophouse staircase where you pay by the hour and DJ your own afternoon — analogue, unhurried, and made for you and a disposable camera.
